body: In `molt_cycle` (shrimp.rs:653-659), `failed_molt_accum * 0.5` is added to `molt_stress_index` after `update_molt_stress()` has already set a baseline. In `compute_mortality_probabilities` (shrimp.rs:1048+1052), `molt_stress_index` enters `stress_total` via `(molt_stress_index - 0.5).max(0.0)` AND `failed_molt_accum` enters independently via `molt_mortality = failed_molt_accum * failed_molt_mortality_scale`. This means `failed_molt_accum` drives mortality through two additive channels simultaneously. Add an inline comment at both sites documenting this intentional double-contribution so future maintainers don't 'fix' one path thinking the other is sufficient.
